scripts.format:fix: bun x prettier --write AGENTS.md README.md CONTRIBUTING.md CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md SECURITY.md CHANGELOG.md RELEASE_NOTES.md package.json turbo.json tsconfig.base.json tsconfig.json .prettierrc.json eslint.config.mjs playwright.config.ts .changeset .github apps examples integrations packages scripts templates tests docs/testing.md
scripts.test:certification: bun test scripts/tests/dev-readiness/bootstrap-imports.test.ts scripts/tests/packed-manifest.test.ts scripts/tests/registry-cache.test.ts scripts/tests/release-command.test.ts packages/cli/tests/dev-snapshot/input-watch.test.ts packages/cli/inspector-startup.test.ts && bun x vitest run scripts/tests/benchmark-packed-cleanup.test.ts scripts/tests/benchmark-packed-dev.test.ts packages/cli/tests/services/inspector-readiness.test.ts

scripts.test:mcp:inspector: RELKIT_MCP_INSPECTOR_CLI=1 bun x vitest run packages/runtime-hono/tests/mcp.test.ts
scripts.test:examples: bunx turbo run check typecheck test build --filter='./examples/*' --concurrency=1
scripts.test:jobs:unit: bun test packages/testing/tests/compatibility/jobs.test.ts && bun x vitest run packages/jobs/tests packages/providers-local/tests packages/engine/tests/materialize-jobs.test.ts
scripts.test:jobs:contracts: bun test tests/contracts/jobs.test.ts && bun x vitest run packages/jobs/tests/task-wire.test.ts packages/jobs/tests/authoring-boundaries.test.ts

scripts.prepush: bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun x prettier --check AGENTS.md README.md CONTRIBUTING.md CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md SECURITY.md CHANGELOG.md RELEASE_NOTES.md package.json turbo.json tsconfig.base.json tsconfig.json .prettierrc.json eslint.config.mjs playwright.config.ts .changeset .github apps examples integrations packages scripts templates tests docs/testing.md && bun run lint && bun run check && bun run konsistent -- validate && bun run scripts/check-observability-sinks.ts && bun x turbo run typecheck --filter='./packages/*' --filter='./integrations/catalog' --filter='./integrations/packages/*' --output-logs=errors-only && bun x tsc -b --pretty false && bun run test:types && bun run test:certification && bun run test:unit && bun test tests/compiler/manifest.test.ts tests/compiler/graph-construction.test.ts tests/compiler/job-names.test.ts && bun run test:graph && bun run test:contracts && bun run test:security
scripts.prepush:full: docker info >/dev/null && bun run verify && bun run test:jobs:docker && bun run test:scaffold && bun run test:container && bun run test:local-docker && bun run test:deployment && bun run test:inspector:browser && bun run test:e2e

scripts.check: bun run generate:check && tsc --noEmit && bun run check:jsdoc && bun run check:links && bun run check:search

scripts.build: tsc -b && bun run ../../scripts/package-editor.ts && bun run ../../scripts/package-inspector.ts && bun run ../../scripts/package-dev-bootstrap.ts

scripts.test:coverage: vitest run --config vitest.config.ts --coverage && bun run scripts/check-coverage.ts

scripts.jobs:trigger: relkit jobs trigger --job exportOrders --input-file examples/export-orders.json --operation-id example-trigger
